known.title: [P1] Exclude generated bytecode from starter file collection

findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Installing the wheel with pip generates `__pycache__/*.pyc` files beside the Python templates by default ([pip implementation](https://github.com/pypa/pip/blob/main/src/pip/_internal/operations/install/wheel.py#L561-L591)). This recursive collection includes those binary files, which `_scaffold` then decodes as UTF-8 at lines 171–172. Consequently, `forge init --starter python` fails with `UnicodeDecodeError` after a normal wheel installation. Exclude bytecode and cache directories, and verify initialization through an installed wheel; checking the wheel ZIP contents alone misses this failure.
